note: Nameplates over the fighters (roadmap 18.6, 17.2; M6). 'show': when the health plate over a head is seen: 'hit' = hidden, it flashes for 'flashMs' when the fighter is hurt or healed, and shows while the fighter is tapped or can be targeted; 'always' = always there (the player can switch in Settings; remembered on the device). 'maxIcons': status icons over a head before the rest become '+2'.

classPlates.note: THE SLOT FOR SULEIMAN'S CLASS NAMEPLATES (he is drawing them, 14 Nov). To wire one: put the picture in public/art/ui/nameplates/ and name it here against the class id from jobs.json, for example "guardian": "guardian.png". It is drawn behind the health bar, 'height' game pixels tall (its width follows the picture), with the bar placed at 'barAt' (0 = top of the picture, 1 = bottom) and 'barWidth' of the picture's width. A class with no picture keeps the plain bar.
